name: Modal pricing - GPU resource costs
notes: Serverless GPU, billed per second, listed in $/sec: H200 SXM $0.001261 = $4.54/GPU-hr; H100 SXM5 $0.001097 = $3.95/GPU-hr; B200 $0.001736 = $6.25; B300 $0.001972 = $7.10; A100 80GB $0.000694 = $2.50; A100 40GB $0.000583 = $2.10; L40S $0.000542 = $1.95; A10 $0.000306 = $1.10; L4 $0.000222 = $0.80; T4 $0.000164 = $0.59. Two modifiers that matter more than the base rate and are stated in the plan table: 'Region selection 1.15 - 1.75x base prices' and 'Non-preemptible execution 3x base prices'. Egress $0.04/GiB with 1 TiB/mo free on Starter, 10 TiB on Team. Modal also transacts through the AWS and GCP marketplaces for committed spend, but AWS/GCP cloud credits themselves are NOT applicable to Modal usage.
